description: Tests for search functionality with edge-case queries. Robustness category Q.

fixtures.expected_behavior: API endpoint /api/search?q= returns valid response without crash. Empty query matches all or returns empty.
fixtures.rationale: The search function must handle empty string input without raising an exception.

fixtures.input_condition: Search query with SQL injection-style characters
fixtures.expected_behavior: API endpoint handles special characters without crash. No SQL injection possible (pipeline is not SQL-backed for search). Returns valid response.
fixtures.rationale: Search operates on in-memory Python data structures. No SQL interpolation. Special characters in query are treated as plain strings.

fixtures.expected_behavior: API endpoint accepts Unicode query parameter. Python string comparison handles Unicode. No crash. Returns empty results (no Devanagari entities in baseline data).
fixtures.rationale: FastAPI handles Unicode URL parameters via URL encoding. Python string contains/lower() work on Unicode strings.

fixtures.expected_behavior: API handles very long query string without crash or timeout. Python string operations are O(n) on query length. Returns valid response.
fixtures.rationale: No query length limits are enforced. Python string operations handle long strings. FastAPI does not enforce URL length limits by default.
